tip: English needs 'has had a fever since' – Indonesian states it flat: demam sejak kemarin malam, no tense change. Sejak alone signals it started then and still holds.
-nya stuck on a noun means his or her: giginya = his tooth (gigi + -nya). No separate word for 'his' – the owner hangs off the end of the noun.
Rumah sakit, literally 'sick house', is the word for hospital. Indonesian compounds put the main noun first – rumah (house) is the thing, sakit just describes it.
